overview_description.description: Respaid is a fintech startup that is revolutionizing debt recovery for businesses. Their platform combines the expertise of amicable debt collectors with AI technology. offer transparent pricing based on successful debt recovery, making it easier for businesses to manage their cash flow.

about_short_description.short_description: Respaid is a tech company that uses AI and debt collectors to recover debt for businesses.

product.name: AI-Powered B2B Debt Collection Service
product.description: A service that uses AI and legal authority to recover unpaid B2B invoices while maintaining respectful communication to protect client brand reputation.

product.name: Data Cleaning and Contact Discovery
product.description: A service that cleans and updates debtor contact information using AI and proprietary sources to improve communication success rates.

product.name: Direct Payment Processing Integration
product.description: A system that enables debtors to pay creditors directly through secure, modern payment channels integrated with client billing systems.

product.name: Automated Collection Campaign Management
product.description: A platform feature that automates the initiation and management of debt collection campaigns with minimal setup and rapid deployment.

product.name: Analytics and Reporting Dashboard
product.description: A dashboard that provides insights into debtor behavior, payment status, and reasons for non-payment to inform collection strategies and business improvements.
